changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('integration.AssetField'))) BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include] ON [integration].[AssetField] ([Section],[SourceID]) INCLUDE ([FieldValue]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('integration.AssetField'))) BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_IntegrationAssetField_Section_SourceID_Include] ON [integration].[AssetField] END
